doc.title: Mark Soskin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 17, 2021

title: Choosing sidemen: Jay Anderson, Matt Wilson, Rich Perry
summary: He picks musicians whose playing he knows will serve his music.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Have you ever had a circumstance where a sideman on your gig, your music, and they’re throwing caution to the wind and have you ever thought like they’re going a little too far with your music?

Well not really because I’m always choosing musicians who I know will take care of business. I always know that they’re going to do what I like them to do. You know say Jay Anderson for one, the bass player. You know I get him because I know what he’s going to do. I know kind of the way he plays and I know the way Matt Wilson plays. And I know how Rich Perry plays you know so I know what they’re going to do.
Oh Matt Wilson, yeah. He’s marvelous.
He’s been on a few of my records.
